title: Somebody's Already in the Air

mood.label: Uneasy, one narrow opening
mood.summary: Forty-two out of a hundred: US envoys carry a peace plan toward Moscow and Kyiv while Russian drones kill dozens, Iran strike threats hold, haze shuts Sarawak's schools and a Bolivian base explodes - a strong jobs report and two tunnel rescues the only counterweight.

lines: Two envoys and a folder, wheels up toward Moscow -
first real movement in months, and nobody says peace.
Over Kyiv the jet-drones came in low all night;
Sarawak shut six hundred schools to breathe.
A hundred sixty-two thousand jobs, and diesel at a record.
Ten gone at a base outside La Paz.
Nine days down a flooded tunnel, two men walked out -
and the UN redrew Africa the size it always was.
Forty-two out of a hundred, and the air is somebody's cargo:
a peace plan, a warhead threat, the smoke that crossed the sea.
We're tired in the way that watching makes you tired.
Hold the thin thread. Don't ask it to hold me.
